ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) field (~80%) interspersed with localized high-intensity (white) pigment clusters (~20%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains isolated circular high-contrast rings. Right lobe displays a large, distal contiguous white region with internal dark mottling. White pigmentation is also concentrated along the anterior margin of the right tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression; angle approximately 40 degrees with a clear vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 2-10 pixels along the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trajectory for both lobes, tapering to acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed white circular rosette patterns (barnacle scars) distributed across the mid-section of the left lobe and the lower-central region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, nearly vertical white linear markings on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, three-dimensional calcified barnacle clusters localized on the extreme outer tips (points) of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'island' pattern of dark pigment within the large white patch on the right lobe's distal surface.
